request.text: What are the main kinds of clouds?

reply.raw:
The main kinds are classified by shape and height: cirrus (high, wispy), cumulus (puffy, fair-weather), and stratus (flat, low, grey sheets). Cumulonimbus, the tall storm cloud, combines the puffy and high forms.
